title: Coherent realization inclusions have free mapping-simplex cell presentations
statement:
Use the small simplicial sets, standard simplices and universes of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones] and the subset-poset coherent realization $\mathfrak C$ and small simplicial categories of [lem-coef-pinched-cube-latching]. For a small simplicial set $T$, define $U(T)$ to have two objects $0,1$, mapping simplicial set $U(T)(0,1)=T$, empty $U(T)(1,0)$, and both endomorphism simplicial sets $\Delta^0$, with identity compositions. Write $\mathbf 1$ for the one-object identity simplicial category. For every degreewise injective map $i:X\hookrightarrow Y$ of small simplicial sets, $\mathfrak C[i]$ identifies its source with a simplicial subcategory of $\mathfrak C[Y]$ and has a countable cellular presentation
$$D_0=\mathfrak C[X]\ \hookrightarrow\ D_1\ \hookrightarrow\ D_2\ \hookrightarrow\cdots,\qquad \operatorname{colim}_{j<\omega}D_j\cong\mathfrak C[Y].$$
All stages are simplicial subcategories of $\mathfrak C[Y]$ and all transition maps are their inclusions. Each transition is a pushout, in small simplicial categories, of a small coproduct of maps $\varnothing\to\mathbf 1$ and $U(\partial\Delta^r)\to U(\Delta^r)$, $r\geq0$. Each mapping-simplex cell has a top $r$-simplex whose image in $D_{j+1}$ is not in $D_j$. If $i$ is bijective on vertices, the presentation can be chosen with every stage having that same object set, with identity object maps, and with no $\varnothing\to\mathbf 1$ cells. No Kan or finiteness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Riehl–Verity, Recognizing quasi-categorical limits and colimits in homotopy coherent nerves, Definition 5.1.4 and its following equivalence (printed p.27), Lemma 5.1.9 (p.29), Proposition 5.1.12 (p.30). The relative presentation can attach the missing nondegenerate atomic arrows dimension by dimension; in the fixed-object case no object cells occur, as also used in the proof of Theorem 5.2.6, pp.33–34. Read online; archival copy WANTED. No Stacks tag states this simplicial-enriched result.
